items.title: Why Does NVDA Stock Carry The Lowest Clean Multiple In Its Peer Group?
items.summary: NVIDIA (NVDA) is the strongest business in its peer group, and it is priced below every rival you can compare it with fairly, at 27.5 times earnings. Yet over the past twelve months NVDA returned 25.7% while AMD returned 239.7%. The best business in the group is one of its weakest stocks, and not because anyone doubts the demand.

items.title: Micron Just Built One Memory Stick That Replaces Four. Is MU Stock a Buy?

items.title: What Needs To Be True To Buy Qualcomm Stock Now?
items.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) told investors in its fiscal Q3 2026 call that its share of Apple's recent iPhone launch would be materially lower than its prior estimate of 20%. In the same call, management raised its non-handset revenue target for fiscal 2029 to $40 billion—nearly doubling its prior $22 billion goal as automotive, IoT, and data center expand. Anyone buying the stock today is deciding whether that replacement revenue arrives on schedule.
